sources.exact_title: Weak Memory Model Formalisms: Introduction and Survey
sources.date_version_edition: 2026, Concurrency and Computation: Practice and Experience 38(2)
sources.exact_section_page_theorem_table_figure_: Sections introducing operational and axiomatic formalisms, hardware/compiler reorderings, verification tools, complexity, and open directions.
sources.claim_supported: Concurrent correctness depends on the exact hardware/language memory model; source-order interleavings are inadequate for weak-memory behaviours.
sources.contrary_evidence_if_any: Survey evidence maps formalisms rather than comparing end-to-end industrial effectiveness.
sources.open_access_status: Self-archived arXiv version and publisher DOI located.

sources.author_or_organisation: Paschal C. Amusuo, Owen Cochell, Taylor Le Lievre, Parth V. Patil, Aravind Machiry, and James C. Davis
sources.exact_title: Do Unit Proofs Work? An Empirical Study of Compositional Bounded Model Checking for Memory Safety Verification
sources.exact_section_page_theorem_table_figure_: arXiv:2503.13762v1, §§3–7; 73 unit proofs for four embedded operating systems, recreated-defect results, additional defects, development/execution effort, generalisability, and threats to validity.
sources.claim_supported: Focused compositional bounded-model-checking obligations found 74% of recreated memory-safety defects at the baseline bounds, a further 9% at increased bounds, and 19 new defects in the studied systems, with reported nontrivial development and execution effort.
sources.contrary_evidence_if_any: Preprint, selected systems/defects, and no universal ROI inference.
sources.open_access_status: Open arXiv preprint.

sources.author_or_organisation: Hanna Lachnitt, Mathias Fleury, Haniel Barbosa, Jibiana Jakpor, Bruno Andreotti, Andrew Reynolds, Hans-Jörg Schurr, Clark Barrett, and Cesare Tinelli
sources.exact_title: Improving the SMT Proof Reconstruction Pipeline in Isabelle/HOL
sources.exact_section_page_theorem_table_figure_: ITP 2025, LIPIcs 352, Article 26, pp. 26:1–26:22; cvc5 Alethe production, Isabelle reconstruction, format defects and fixes, evaluation, and limitations.
sources.claim_supported: SMT results can be accompanied by proof artefacts reconstructed in an independent proof assistant, reducing blind solver trust.
sources.contrary_evidence_if_any: Coverage of solver rules/preprocessing and reconstruction performance remain evolving.
sources.open_access_status: Open-access DROPS article.

sources.author_or_organisation: Joseph E. Reeves, Haniel Barbosa, Andrew Reynolds, and Marijn J. H. Heule
sources.exact_title: A General Approach for SMT Proof Skeletons
sources.exact_section_page_theorem_table_figure_: IJCAR 2026, LNCS/LNAI 16688, pp. 156–174; §§1–4 and 7; preprocessing/clausification/theory-lemma skeleton, external SAT reasoning, proof trimming, batched justification, evaluation, and stated theory limits.
sources.claim_supported: A useful SMT certificate must justify preprocessing and theory reasoning as well as the final SAT core.
sources.contrary_evidence_if_any: Current prototypes do not yet cover every solver optimisation or theory combination.
sources.open_access_status: Publisher locator and author material located.

sources.exact_title: CompCert C Reference Manual
sources.exact_section_page_theorem_table_figure_: Chapter 1 and language/target chapters; accepted ISO C subset, extensions/exclusions, supported architectures, compiler options, and semantic guarantees.
sources.claim_supported: Current CompCert guarantees apply to specified language subsets, targets, options, and source behaviours, not arbitrary C or arbitrary build chains.
sources.contrary_evidence_if_any: Project documentation is authoritative for scope but not independent effectiveness evidence.
sources.open_access_status: Open official documentation.

sources.author_or_organisation: Yutong Xin, Qiaochu Chen, Greg Durrett, and Işil Dillig
sources.exact_title: VeriSoftBench: Repository-Scale Formal Verification Benchmarks for Lean
sources.exact_section_page_theorem_table_figure_: arXiv:2602.18307v1; 500 obligations from 23 Lean repositories, repository/dependency-preserving benchmark construction, model/prover evaluation, context experiments, and threats to validity.
sources.claim_supported: Performance on mathematics-heavy or synthetic Lean benchmarks does not reliably transfer to real software-verification obligations.
sources.contrary_evidence_if_any: Preprint benchmark size and repository selection bound generalisation.
sources.open_access_status: Open arXiv preprint.

sources.author_or_organisation: Michele Chiari, Matteo Camilli, Marcello M. Bersani, Rutger van Beusekom, and Damian A. Tamburri
sources.exact_title: Reality Check on Formal Methods in Industry: A Study of Verum Dezyne
sources.date_version_edition: 2025, Journal of Software: Evolution and Process 37(12)
sources.exact_section_page_theorem_table_figure_: Journal of Software: Evolution and Process 37(12), pp. 1–16; industrial Verum Dezyne case, practitioner survey/comparison, adoption and integration evidence, benefits, barriers, and validity limits.
sources.claim_supported: A detailed industrial case shows substantial but localised formal-method use whose value, scale and integration depend on organisational and domain conditions; it does not establish universal adoption or payoff.
sources.contrary_evidence_if_any: The study is centred on one formal framework and a bounded industrial population, so prevalence and causal effectiveness do not generalise automatically.
sources.open_access_status: Open repository copy and DOI located.

sources.exact_title: AC 20-148: Reusable Software Components
sources.exact_section_page_theorem_table_figure_: Sections on configuration control, usage domain, assumptions, verification credit, change impact, and reusable-component evidence.
sources.claim_supported: Reusable assurance evidence remains conditional on declared usage domains, configuration, assumptions, and change control.
sources.contrary_evidence_if_any: Certification guidance states obligations; it is not independent evidence that an implementation satisfies them.
sources.open_access_status: Open FAA PDF.
